snippet.title: Bendy and the Ink Machine VR - Trailer
snippet.description:
UPDATE: **THE MOD HAS RELEASED!**

BendyVR is a PCVR mod by BaggyG of Team Beef for Bendy and the Ink Machine (2017) by Joey Drew Studios.

**Mod download and Instructions:** https://github.com/baggyg/BendyVR
Steam game page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/622650/Bendy_and_the_Ink_Machine/

Join the Team Beef Discord (https://discord.gg/bAe2uaztQj) for upcoming news. 
Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/teambeef

(https://store.steampowered.com/app/622650/Bendy_and_the_Ink_Machine/). 


The mod does not contain any copyrighted assets from the original game.
This trailer is a mashup of in-game recorded video with BendyVR and the original Bendy and the Ink Machine trailers used under the "Fair Use" condition:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7c_xdTnVPos and
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kU4w0WgUh18.
